While I'm literally amazed by how good of a performer boo is I'd still say if there's only one who can be in performance unit, dino is taking that position

Although it makes sense too since Dino is actually a member of performance unit. Although boo actually danced better than most of the vocals out there and actually better than even like half of the actual performers, so you gotta give the man credit for it

Although I really don't understand the sense of having units in svt. I've seen their performance units sing better than many vocals.
